experiment: EV-10 R2/R3 model-group extension, frozen baseline G

evaluation.metric: G = A - H(C); A = expected first-attempt success (group pass probability of the start tier), C = mean first-attempt price, H = best fixed start tier or mixture with first-attempt cost <= C

cost_levels.definition: fraction of each source's range between the cheapest and the dearest fixed start tier, first attempt only (dev)

evaluation.selection: 07b adapters (5-fold cross-fitted on dev); setting score = dev G of the tau rule (tau = .8), mean over the four sources
evaluation.lambda: one-shot rule argmax(p_hat - lambda x price); per source and level the lambda whose dev first-attempt cost is closest to the target (07b grid)

extension.selection: one fixed final checkpoint per new method; only adapters and lambda fitted on dev
extension.test_reuse: follow-up comparison on the existing test; not a new unseen test
